en: A black-and-white multi-view postcard featuring five images of Lomma, including a large church ('Kyrkan'), a main street lined with houses and trees ('Storgatan'), a harbor scene with boats ('Hamnparti'), a sandy beach with people swimming and sunbathing ('Strandbaden'), and a river with boats and greenery ('Åparti'). The postcard is labeled with 'LOMMA' at the top and photographic credit at the bottom.
